scenes.sub: Assalamu alaikum. Have you ever paid for a Quran class that never happened?

scenes.h1: Pay only for classes that take place
scenes.sub: At Nurul Huda Academy, you pay only for classes that take place.
If the teacher misses a class, that class is not charged.
If you cancel at least 12 hours before, there is no charge either.
And after every class that does happen, you get a short report.
Book a free trial class at nurulhudaacademy.org
